prompt:
Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1137
Claimant:
Anna Farmer
Adjuster:
Christopher Wong
June 7, 2023
Claim received by phone from the claimant, who reports a side impact at a signalized intersection while proceeding
through on a green light. The claimant is not represented by an attorney and has asked for guidance on the claim
process.
June 12, 2023
Reviewed the policy and confirmed the driver of the insured vehicle lives with the policyholder and is covered as a
household member. Coverage was in force at the time of loss.
July 7, 2023
Spoke with the other driver, who described the collision the same way the claimant did. Pohtos from the scene show
the damage on the driver's side of the claimant's vehicle.
July 18, 2023
Police report obtained. Officers confirm the claimant was in the vehicle at the scene and note the positions of both
cars consistent with a side impact.
August 6, 2023
Two independent witnesses gave stateemnts that match the sequence of events reported by both drivers. Neither
witness has any known connection to the parties.
August 30, 2023
Repair estimate received. The location and pattern of damage on the claimant's vehicle match the described impact.
No earlier damage to the vehicle is known from prior claims or inspection records.
September 13, 2023
Claimant reports neck and back strain following the collision and was evaluated at an urgent care clinic the same day.
Records are requested to confirm the diagnosis.
September 29, 2023
Claimant has described the accident and symptoms the same way in each call and written statmeent so far. Nothing
in the account has changed between conversations.
October 10, 2023
Medical review is still open. It is not yet clear whether the neck and back complaints came from this crash, as the
claimant's records need to be compared with the timeline of symptoms.
October 11, 2023
Treatment records show a usual course of care, including physical therapy and medication, with visits tapering as the
claimant improved. Billing reviewed and appears consistent with the treatment notes.
October 23, 2023
Prior records show the claimant had a minor strain in the same area years ago that healed fully with no ongoing care.
The history is noted for the medical reviewer, who will consider it alongside the current findings.
January 24, 2024
File under review. Libaility appears clear based on the police report, witness statements, and damgae pattern. Injury
evaluation remains pending the medical reviewer's opinion on causation.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
JSON format:
